Add runGitMutation, a repo-scoped advisory lock (github.com/gofrs/flock)
acquired before index/ref-writing git commands so concurrent wipnote
processes serialize BEFORE reaching git's own index.lock contention path.

- Lock lives in the per-user cache dir (~/.cache/wipnote/<path-hash>/
  git-mutation.lock), a sibling of the SQLite read-index, reusing
  storage.CanonicalDBPath's path-hash keying. Never inside .git/ and
  outside the working tree so it is never committed.
- flock auto-releases on process death, so the lock can never go stale
  (rationale for flock over a pidfile).
- runGitWithLockRetry is RETAINED, not replaced: runGitMutation acquires
  the advisory lock and runs the command through runGitWithLockRetry
  inside the locked section, so external-writer (IDE, gitstatus daemon)
  contention is still handled by the backoff loop.
- Wire commitWipnoteArtifact and commitWipnoteArtifactStrict git add /
  git commit through runGitMutation; read-only calls left unchanged.
- gitMutationLockPath seam mirrors gitRunner/gitLockSleep for concurrency
  tests; production code never reassigns it.
